instruction: Make the fifth and seventh paragraphs in your document bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying bold formatting to paragraphs 4 and 6 (5th and 7th paragraphs). Custom getter extracts bold status from specified paragraphs, metric verifies they are bold. Postconfig saves the file to persist changes.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts bold formatting status from the specified paragraphs (indices 4 and 6, corresponding to 5th and 7th paragraphs)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_bold') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules')
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both required paragraphs (5th and 7th) are bold
Data flow is correct: getter returns Dict[int, bool], metric compares boolean values with strict equality, which is appropriate for bold formatting verification
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to persist formatting changes before verification
Expected values are semantically correct: paragraphs 4 and 6 (0-indexed) map to 5th and 7th paragraphs as required by the instruction
Getter logic robustly checks all text runs in each paragraph and handles edge cases (empty paragraphs, no text runs)
